Explanation: The core value unit is the design that solves the client brief, whether it is selected from a contest or created through a direct 1-to-1 Project.
99designs by Vista operates the marketplace, curates designers, runs contests and 1-to-1 Projects, handles payments and sets marketplace rules.
The platform has to connect a client brief with designers whose style and skills fit the work.
More successful contests and direct projects create fees, repeat work and stronger designer-client relationships.
Poor submissions, copied work, payment disputes or weak matching can make creative work harder to buy online.
99designs organizes briefs, contest prizes, 1-to-1 quotes, protected payments and platform fees.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Brief / Pay — The client sends a design brief, chooses a contest or direct project and funds the work through 99designs. | → Provider · Contest / Project — 99designs makes the brief available as a contest or routes direct project work to an eligible designer. | ← Provider · Design / Quote — Designers submit concepts in contests or send quotes and work through 1-to-1 Projects. | → Consumer · Ideas / Files — The platform presents contest concepts or direct-project work and delivers final files after approval and handover.

Explanation: 99designs curates new designers, assigns designer levels and applies originality, contest and client rules.
99designs attracts clients through search, its own brand, design content and the wider Vista ecosystem.
The platform reviews designers, distributes briefs, supports feedback, transfers files and manages disputes and payments.
Its core resources include the designer community, portfolios, contest history, reviews, briefs and marketplace software.
Clients are entrepreneurs, small businesses, brands and other buyers that need professional design work.
Clients want a design that fits their brief, brand, budget and deadline.
A contest can show the client several creative directions before they commit to one winning design.
Clients still have to explain the brief clearly, compare subjective creative options and give useful feedback.
Clients create a brief, choose a contest or direct project, provide feedback and fund the work.

Explanation: The right designer or concept must fit the desired style, category, quality level, budget and timing.
Clients can open a brief to many designers in a contest or work directly with one designer in a 1-to-1 Project.
Clients describe the work, review concepts or quotes, give feedback, choose a designer and approve final files.

Designers are curated freelance creatives who can enter contests or work directly with clients.
Designers want to turn their creative skills into paid work and build client relationships and reputation.

Explanation: Designers must pass curation and are placed into Entry, Mid or Top Level based on quality and platform performance.
Designers can enter open contests or receive and accept direct 1-to-1 work from clients.
Designers interpret briefs, create concepts, respond to feedback, revise designs and hand over final files.
Designers contribute creative skill, software, time, portfolios, style knowledge and professional reputation.
Hyperwallet, a PayPal service, is the exclusive payout provider for 99designs designers as of January 2026.
The payout partner has to move designer earnings reliably across countries and available local payout methods.
Marketplace activity creates recurring international payout transactions for the payment partner.
Cross-border payouts require identity checks, compliant accounts and country-specific payout coverage.
Hyperwallet receives payout instructions and moves cleared designer earnings to supported accounts or methods.
Transaction Flows: → Provider · Payout — Hyperwallet moves cleared designer earnings from 99designs to supported payout methods.

Explanation: A designer needs an eligible, verified Hyperwallet account connected to the 99designs profile.
Designers connect and manage Hyperwallet through the earnings and payout setup flow.
Hyperwallet processes payout instructions and supports region-specific withdrawal methods.
The partner contributes payout infrastructure, account verification and local payment coverage.
